mapper.select: select r.id,r.role_code as roleCode,r.role_name as roleName from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
select r.id, r.role_code as roleCode, r.role_name as roleName from sys_role r order by r.id asc

select p.id,p.permission_code as permissionCode,p.permission_name as permissionName from sys_permission p where p.id in (select rp.permission_id from sys_role_permission rp where rp.role_id=#{roleId}) ORDER BY p.id ASC
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{roleId} FOR UPDATE
